title: Minions
summary: Minions gather for you on your island, even while you're offline. All 61 of Hypixel's minions, with their real speeds, storage and upgrade costs.

s.x: is a little helper you place on your island. It works the ground around it and fills its storage with what it gathers, even while you're offline. There are

kinds, from the Cobblestone Minion to the Inferno Minion, each with up to 12 tiers. Every number comes from Hypixel: time between actions, storage, what each one collects, and what each upgrade costs.

Each minion works in its own way:

rows.x: Places its block on the empty spots around it, at the height of the block it stands on, then mines them.
Plants on the ground around it, then harvests.
Grows logs on the outer ring around it, then chops them.
Spawns its mob next to it, then kills it.

s.x: Give a mining minion room: leave the 5 by 5 around it
(air) at the level of the block it stands on. It fills every empty spot first, then mines one each time and refills the gap, so it harvests on every other action.
A minion keeps time with the real clock. When you come back, it has done everything it would have done while you were gone, up to what its storage holds. When its storage is full it stops, and

Only the profile's members can open a minion.

Fuel makes a minion work faster while it burns. Put a stack in and it burns one item after another, in real time, even while you're offline. The screen shows what's burning and how long it has left. Burning fuel can't be taken back out, except fuel that lasts forever. You can only add more of the same fuel.

A minion has two upgrade slots. Speed upgrades add up with each other and with the fuel.

rows.x: Smelts what it makes: Cobblestone into Stone, ores into ingots, logs into Charcoal, Sand into Glass...
Turns what it makes into block form: 9 Coal into a Block of Coal, Snowballs into Snow Blocks.

Turns what it makes into its enchanted form once there's enough in storage: 160 Cobblestone into an Enchanted Cobblestone, then on into enchanted blocks. A minion needs room for 160 items for this to work.
Smelts first, then does what the Super Compactor does.
1 Diamond for every 10 items the minion makes, on average.
A tiny chance at a Red Gift for every item.
Reaches 1 block further (a 7 by 7) and works 5% faster.
Works 25% faster during the SkyBlock day.
Chicken Minions only: an extra Egg from every chicken.
Gravel Minions only: always Flint, never Gravel.
Sheep Minions only: shears every sheep for extra Wool.
Halves what the minion makes, but adds a Raw Soulflow every 3 minutes / 90 seconds.

s.x: Two of the same upgrade only count twice for the speed ones (Minion Expander, Flycatcher). An upgrade that doesn't fit the minion does nothing. Picking a minion up gives back its fuel (minus the one burning), its hopper and its upgrades.
